source.section: Form NJ-1040 lines 15, 16a, 20a, 27, 28a, 28b, 29: Instr PDF p.21 line 27, PDF p.22 line 28a (Line A, Line B and chart), PDF p.22 line 28b and PDF p.23 Worksheet D lines 1-9 (lines 4-8: lines 15, 18, 21 and 22 added; 'Is the amount on line 8 MORE than $3,000?') with the Maximum Exclusion chart, PDF p.22 line 29; GIT-1 & 2 p.23 condition 3 (earned income 'combined if filing jointly' must be $3,000 or less); PDF p.8 lines 6-7 (regular and senior 65+ exemptions), PDF p.9 line 13, PDF p.25 line 30, PDF p.27 lines 38-39, PDF p.33 lines 42-43, PDF p.65 Tax Rate Schedules

worked: Federal AGI 93,000.01 (wages 3,000.01 + private pension 20,000.00 + interest 70,000.00); federal taxable income = 93,000.01 - 15,750.00 federal standard deduction = 77,250.01 (given, not tested; age 64, so no age-65 amount; the federal senior deduction is ignored). Line 15 wages 3,000.01 + line 16a interest 70,000.00 + line 20a pension 20,000.00 = line 27 total income 93,000.01 (projection: federal AGI less taxable Social Security 0.00); measure 93,000.01, in the 0-100,000 band (keep share 1). Line 28a: age 64; Line A 20,000.00, Line B 75,000.00; lesser = 20,000.00. Worksheet D: line 27 is not more than 150,000; line 1 75,000.00 - line 2 20,000.00 = line 3 55,000.00 (more than 0); line 4 (line 15 wages) 3,000.01 + lines 5-7 0.00 = line 8 3,000.01, which is MORE than 3,000: 'You are not eligible to use the unclaimed portion of your maximum exclusion', so line 28b = 0.00 (projection: earned income 3,000.01 is over the 3,000 per-return limit, so the relief does not apply: 0.00). Line 28c = 20,000.00. Line 29 New Jersey gross income = 93,000.01 - 20,000.00 - 0.00 = 73,000.01. Line 30 exemptions (line 13): regular 1,000 x 1 (nobody is 65 or older, so no senior exemption) = 1,000.00; line 38 = 1,000.00 (no other deductions). Line 39/42 taxable income = 73,000.01 - 1,000.00 = 72,000.01. Line 43 tax, rate schedule Table A (single/separate) as bands: 20,000.00 x 0.014 = 280.00 + 15,000.00 x 0.0175 = 262.50 + 5,000.00 x 0.035 = 175.00 + 32,000.01 x 0.05525 = 1,768.00 (1,768.0005525) = 2,485.50 (2,485.5005525, rounded to the cent). The booklet's Tax Table (taxable income under 100,000) gives 2,487 for the 72,000-72,050 row (schedule at the midpoint 72,025, rounded); expected keeps the exact schedule result. No credits. State income tax = 2,485.50. One cent of wages over the limit costs the whole 55,000.00 unclaimed exclusion: compare nj_2025_unclaimed_earned_at_limit (tax 238.00). The pension is noncontributory, so line 20b is empty.
accepted_approximations: Tax Table: for taxable income under 100,000 New Jersey uses its Tax Table, the schedule's tax at each 50-dollar row's midpoint rounded to the dollar; the projection uses the exact schedule.
